structure.unit: Crimes Against the Administration of Justice

law.catch_line: Officer refusing, delaying, etc., to execute process for criminal
law.text: If any officer willfully and corruptly refuse to execute any lawful process requiring him to apprehend or confine a person convicted of, or charged with, an offense, or willfully and corruptly omit or delay to execute such process, whereby such person shall escape and go at large, such officer shall be guilty of a Class 3 misdemeanor.
